name: Geometry Shader Voxelization
definition: A method for voxelizing polygonal meshes (`.ply` or `.obj`) by rasterizing triangles into a 3D texture using an OpenGL Geometry Shader. The output is a 3D occupancy grid where occupied voxels are marked.
summary: Geometry Shader Voxelization converts polygonal meshes into 3D occupancy grids by rasterizing triangles directly into a 3D texture, ensuring watertightness through explicit 3D spatial overlap testing without traditional depth buffers.
